services.name: Playschool Programs
services.desc: We provide a fun, safe, supervised environment for children from 6 months up to 5 years under the care of registered ECE staff. A morning and afternoon light snack will be provided with indoor play programs to enjoy. Daily crafts and activities are planned to keep your child engaged during their stay at the Playschool. 2025/2026 PLAYSCHOOL HOURSSaturday, January 10, 2026 - Sunday, March 8, 2026Open Saturday & Sunday ONLYMorning 8:30am - 12:00pmAfternoon 12:30pm - 4:00pm*Closed for lunch 12:00pm - 12:30pm We would like to extend the use of the Playschool to our guest(s) please contact playschool@beavervalley.ca to inquire about availability. Guests are to pay up on sign-in on confirmed day.

blurb: Beaver Valley Ski Club is a family-oriented community providing recreational, competitive, and social skiing experiences. They offer alpine programs and lessons for all skill levels and ages, including ski racing and freestyle skiing and snowboarding. The club also hosts events, après-ski activities, and year-round outdoor activities like mountain biking and tennis.
